title: Chapter 152 Ye Lingzhi
content:
Chapter 152 Ye Lingzhi

As soon as these words came out, everyone reacted immediately.

Then they looked at the Devourer with contempt in their eyes.

And the Devourer's figure also paused slightly, and the next moment, his speed suddenly increased.

But the direction was exactly the opposite of everyone else.

"Not good, Your Majesty, that guy is going to run back to the unknown star field!"

A general of the Divine Dynasty suddenly exclaimed.

The people around him also surged with power, obviously to stop the other party from escaping back to the unknown star field.

"He, can't run away."

At this time, Yan Lingyun's cold words resounded through the starry sky again.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun raised her right hand in the air, and in an instant, a golden light full of destructive breath blasted directly in the direction of the Devourer.

"Ah! Woman, you,,"

"Adults, clan leader, save me quickly!!"

With a loud bang.

A huge mushroom cloud suddenly surged at the border, countless spaces were completely torn apart, and even the border barrier of the unknown star field had a hideous crack.

"Ah!!"

At this time, a scream sounded.

Everyone looked in the direction of the sound and found that only half of Shi Chen's body was left, and the other half had been blown into slag.

Seeing this scene, everyone was shocked and couldn't help but gasp.

Is this the Queen of the Divine Dynasty?

It's really terrifying!

Luckily, this is one of us.

"Run, keep running."

Yan Lingyun walked slowly towards the unknown border, constantly mocking Shi Chen.

"Do you really think what I said is a joke?"

Buzz——

The terrifying breath rushed out of Yan Lingyun's body and crushed directly towards Shi Chen in the distance.

In an instant, the space where Shi Chen was completely shattered into nothingness.

At this moment, Shi Chen once again felt the deep despair of the past.

"You, if you kill me, the clan leader will never let you go."

Shi Chen's face was pale and his voice was trembling.

However, upon hearing Shi Chen's threat, Yan Lingyun showed a strange smile.

"A mere defeated general, do you really think that this emperor can do nothing with him?"

Boom!

Yan Lingyun punched out again.

Seeing the fatal fist coming towards him, Shi Chen couldn't stop shaking all over. At this moment, his body couldn't move.

"No!!"

Boom!

The explosion sounded.

Yan Lingyun's face was completely gloomy.

"Woman, I haven't seen you for many years, and you are still so arrogant."

A hoarse voice sounded from the void.

The smoke dissipated, and a familiar face appeared in front of Yan Lingyun.

The leader of the Soul Devouring Clan, Soul Devouring!

"Leader!!"

Seeing the leader of the Soul Devouring Clan, Shi Chen burst into tears. Just now, he was really going to die.

"What? Weren't you afraid of being beaten back then?"

Hearing this, Soul Devouring's eyes suddenly burst.

"I won't fall in the same place twice!"

Yan Lingyun laughed immediately.

"If you are afraid, we can fight in your Soul Devouring Realm."

When these words came out, Soul Devouring was completely enraged.

"The hatred of the past, today's bloodbath!"

"Come and die!"

Boom!

The space exploded, and Soul Devouring rushed directly towards Yan Lingyun.

The powerful fighting pressure continued to vibrate from the void.

"Quick, retreat!"

Seeing this, everyone hurriedly retreated.

They didn't even dare to look at this kind of battle between strong men.

Because if they looked at it for a while, they would explode!

However, what they didn't know was that Yan Lingyun and Soul Devouring were still testing each other until now, and they hadn't used their full strength at all.

Just when everyone was shocked, a lewd laugh suddenly sounded from not far away.

"Now that woman can't take care of you."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

Seeing that Shi Chen had regained his disgusting face, looking at them with a lewd smile.

Seeing this, everyone's face looked a little ugly.

This sinister villain.

"Hey, you only know how to bully the weak?"

At this time, a sudden voice suddenly sounded from the void.

The next moment, a terrifying aura suddenly enveloped Shichen.

"Hmm?"

Shichen's face changed slightly, and he looked at the void with a serious expression.

"Who is here?!"

And the people in Huangcheng and Shenchao also frowned. This voice is very strange. Who is it?

Buzz——

In an instant, a terrifying aura filled with strong death suddenly crushed over, as if it was the god of death from hell, making everyone present sink to the bottom of the valley.

I saw that the space cracked, and a man in a black robe slowly stepped out of the space crack.

Seeing the person coming, Shichen's face was solemn.

And everyone was puzzled.

Who is this?

"Half-step mortal realm?"

At this time, Shichen slowly spoke.

The man said indifferently, "It's enough to deal with you."

"Oh, arrogant!"

.........

At the same time, in a palace standing on the other side of the starry sky.

Here lives a super family with terrifying strength, which can even influence the heavens and the worlds by stomping their feet.

The Ye family.

"Senior, I was wrong, please forgive me, don't torture me anymore."

A middle-aged man with a swollen and blue face, who was unbearable to look at, lay on the ground and kept begging the man in front of him.

And around, corpses were everywhere and blood flowed like a river!

"You have to understand what my purpose is in teaching you a lesson."

Lu Daosheng looked at the middle-aged man in front of him with a calm expression.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the middle-aged man nodded repeatedly, "I know, I'm sorry for Lingzhi, no, I'm sorry for Lingyun."

Just a while ago.

The Ye clan was still safe and sound, looking forward to the future grand ambitions.

At this time, a strange man suddenly stepped into the gate of the Ye clan, without saying a word, swept all the masters of the Ye clan with an invincible force, and finally sat on the throne of the Ye clan leader, looking down and said: "Do you know you are wrong?"

For this, the entire Ye clan was all confused.

Until Lu Daosheng revealed his identity, they barely understood.

This is actually the husband of the clan leader's daughter!

The clan leader's daughter, named Ye Lingzhi, is a gifted monster. As early as when she was very young, she showed the talent that defied the heavens.

Unfortunately, the Ye clan did not pay much attention to women.

A typical family that favors boys over girls.

So no matter how evil Ye Lingzhi is, her future destiny is destined to become a tool for the family to gain benefits.

In the end, as expected, the patriarch of the Ye clan, Ye Lingzhi's biological father, forced Ye Lingzhi to marry the young master of the Dome Palace for the benefit of the family.

The two forces joined forces to achieve great things together.

That day, the entire other side of the starry sky was boiling.

The alliance of two super forces is not a simple matter.

Countless forces came to watch this feat.

In the end, the accident also happened under the witness of countless forces.

Ye Lingzhi instantly killed the young master of the Dome Palace in full view of the public, shocking the heavens and the world!
